correctness.rationale: For any colorful edge the two fixed cosets force the third; all sheets therefore meet only at vertices. Choosing lifts of the first two cosets and the negative of their sum for the third gives exactly the cyclic generator-shift model on H, even for a nonsplit extension. Alternating the two distinct matching edges translates by ±t, giving one 2m-cycle per sheet vertex, including m=2. Opposite signs on the two triangle layers give a coherent orientation and χ=3m−m². Each original vertex belongs to d sheets. The replacement by attachment intervals collapses along disjoint contractible CW stars to X; the attaching maps from points can alternatively be moved to sheet basepoints up to homotopy by the homotopy-pushout description. Sheet nodes with common first or second coset connect through an original vertex, so a spanning tree leaves 3Nd−3N−d²+1 loops. This proves the integral wedge; for Z/6 the shifts 2,3 give respectively (four tori,15 circles) and (nine spheres,28 circles). The archived F2 checks are illustrative only and were not executed.
